title: Crimson Desert tops 2M sales within a day of launch
content: Pearl Abyss's open-world action RPG Crimson Desert has surpassed 2 million copies sold within 24 hours of its global launch on PC and consoles. The title, which spent several years in development after multiple delay announcements, marks a significant commercial milestone for the Korean developer. The strong sales performance suggests growing appetite for premium single-player RPGs from Asian studios competing in the Western market. Pearl Abyss CEO stated the result exceeded internal projections.
